facts.text: I would like to start a podcast.
The podcast will have two old friends who have known each other for over twenty years.
Michael thinks the world is going to fall in and that money should be in cash.
Billy thinks markets will have ups and downs and that you need to stay invested for the long term and ignore the news.
Michael and Billy send messages back and forth in a WhatsApp group.
The WhatsApp group is boring for their other friends.
One of the friends suggested starting a podcast.
Neither Michael nor Billy really know what they are talking about.
